faq.q: Does leaving the camera mean the buyer receives my account?
faq.a: Do not treat the physical device and your personal account as the same thing. Confirm what equipment stays, then follow the actual manufacturer's instructions for changing device ownership or account association.

faq.q: Is restarting a camera the same as factory resetting it?
faq.a: No. Google's Nest guidance distinguishes a restart that retains settings from a factory reset that removes personalized settings and video history. Other products require their own current instructions.

faq.q: Does removing a device automatically cancel its subscription?
faq.a: Do not assume that. Check the provider's current instructions and your billing account separately. Google's account-transfer guidance treats device removal and subscription cancellation as distinct steps.

faq.q: Should I reset everything when an offer is accepted?
faq.a: Do not use offer acceptance alone as a handoff instruction. Confirm authorization, the agreed possession plan, records that need attention and any continuing security needs before changing access or deleting data.
